user.title: Transport for NSW API key
user.description:
Create an API token at the [TfNSW Open Data Hub](https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au) (Profile → API Tokens). Paste **only the token** — do not include the word `apikey`.

{error_detail}

route.title: Bus route
route.description: Enter the public route number. Default is **311**. The full timetable download happens later in the background — this step only saves your route.

stop.title: Bus stop
stop.description: Choose a curated Potts Point stop, or enter a custom stop ID.

custom_stop.title: Custom stop
custom_stop.description: Enter a GTFS stop_id or public stop code.

direction.title: Travel direction
direction.description: Filter live buses and arrivals by direction. Prefer Sydney CBD for Macleay St toward the city.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The TfNSW API key is no longer valid. Enter a new key.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key (401/403). Create a new token under Profile → API Tokens, and paste only the token value.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach api.transport.nsw.gov.au. Check Home Assistant internet access, then retry. Details are in the HA log under sydney_transport_live.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check Home Assistant logs for sydney_transport_live.
error.route_not_found: That route number was not found in the buses GTFS bundle.
error.interval_too_low: Interval is below the allowed minimum.

abort.already_configured: This route, stop, and direction are already configured.

init.title: Sydney Transport Live options
init.description: Adjust route, stop, direction, and polling intervals. Position interval minimum is 5s; departure minimum is 10s. Departure sensors also tick every 1s for m:ss countdowns.

error.interval_too_low: Interval is below the allowed minimum.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Request an immediate refresh of vehicle positions and departures.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional. Limit the refresh to one config entry.

clear_cache.name: Clear GTFS cache
clear_cache.description: Delete the cached static buses GTFS ZIP and download it again.

entry_id.name: Config entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional. Limit the cache clear to one config entry.
